versions.subject: New sigma rule to detect the use of Jlaive antivirus defense evasion
versions.detection:
parent_selection:
  ParentImage|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
  ParentCommandLine|endswith: '.bat'
selection1:
  Image|endswith: '\xcopy.exe'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - 'powershell.exe'
    - '.bat.exe'
selection2:
  Image|endswith: '\attrib.exe'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - '+s'
    - '+h'
    - '.bat.exe'
condition: parent_selection and (1 of selection*)
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\cmd.exe" ParentCommandLine="*.bat" (Image="*\\xcopy.exe" CommandLine="*powershell.exe*" CommandLine="*.bat.exe*") OR (Image="*\\attrib.exe" CommandLine="*+s*" CommandLine="*+h*" CommandLine="*.bat.exe*")
